blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Efficient video human pose estimation must balance localisation accuracy, motion quality, and energy cost. We present SpikePose, a lightweight video pose estimator that pairs a frame-reset, single-step spiking encoder with motion-aligned heatmap memory (MAM). The encoder supplies per-frame spatial evidence, while MAM estimates joint displacement, aligns historical heatmaps, and adaptively fuses them with current predictions. By confining temporal reasoning to a compact, lightweight module outside the spiking backbone, SpikePose helps bridge the gap between spiking and classical Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) on large-scale, non-event-driven video tasks. We evaluate spatial accuracy, motion errors, and estimated arithmetic energy on MPII and a fixed NTU60 Cross-Subject subset. Against the architecture-matched ANN with MAM, SpikePose cuts estimated arithmetic energy by 91.4% at a cost of just 1.12 points in head-bone-normalised PCK at 0.5 threshold (PCK_HB(0.5)). Within SpikePose, adding MAM reduces velocity and acceleration errors by 28.13% and 31.46% while slightly improving localisation, at a cost of only 0.003M parameters and 0.0023 analytical GFLOPs per frame. Code will be released on GitHub upon acceptance.
blocks.zh: 高效的视频人造姿势估计必须平衡定位准确性、运动质量和能源成本。 我们介绍SpikePose,一个轻量级的视频,呈现出一个帧重置,单步跳动的编码器与运动相匹配的热映射内存(MAM)对齐的模拟器. 编码器提供每个框架的空间证据,而MAM则估计联合转移,使历史热图一致,并适应性地将它们与目前的预测联系起来。 SpikePose通过将时间推理限制在悬浮骨干外的紧凑,轻量级模块,帮助弥合悬浮与古典人工神经网络(ANN)在大规模,非事件驱动的视频任务上的差距. 我们评估MPII和一个固定的NTU60交叉子集上的空间精确度,运动误差,以及估计的算术能量. 与建筑匹配的ANN与MAM相比,SpikePose削减了91.4%的算术能量,成本仅为0.5阈值的1.12分(PCK_HB(0.5)。 在SpikePose内部,加入MAM会降低速度和加速误差28.13%和31.46%,同时略微改善本地化,每帧成本只有0.003M参数和0.0023分析GFLOP. 密码在接受后会在GitHub上发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 2D Video human pose estimation (HPE) requires accurate joint localisation and reliable motion trajectories. Frame-wise backbones such as ResNet-50 Baselines [ 1 , 2 ] and HRNet [ 3 ] provide strong spatial representations but do not explicitly use video history. Temporal approaches introduce feature warping, aggregation, and space–time modelling [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Processing high-dimensional temporal features increases computational costs, motivating a joint examination of localisation, motion quality, and arithmetic energy efficiency.
blocks.zh: 二维 视频人类姿势估计(HPE)需要准确的联合定位和可靠的运动轨迹. ResNet-50基线[1,2]和HRNet[3]等框架主干线提供了强大的空间表现,但没有明确使用视频历史. 时间方法引入了定时、汇总和时空模型[4、5、6、7、8]。 处理高维度时间特征提高了计算成本,促使对本地化、运动质量和计算能效进行联合审查。

blocks.en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offers an alternative computational primitive for spatial encoding [ 9 ] . Bio-inspired SNN units accumulate inputs into a continuous membrane potential and emit a discrete spike after crossing a threshold before the potential resets or decays. This thresholded, event-driven behaviour replaces the dense multiplication operations of analog neural networks with sparse, accumulation-based updates, which is a key reason of the energy efficiency broadly reported for SNNs. SNNs are, however, natively formulated for asynchronous event streams. A central open challenge is scaling them to tasks such as image and video understanding that are not intrinsically event-based, where inputs arrive as dense synchronous frames [ 10 ] . Thresholded spiking activations have been applied to object detection and visual backbones by supplying static images and unrolling membrane dynamics over several steps [ 11 , 12 ] . Video introduces an important distinction: the internal update index τ \tau describes neural dynamics applied to an observation, whereas the physical frame index t t advances only when a new observation is acquired. Increasing τ \tau at a fixed t t may refine the same image representation, but it cannot reveal inter-frame displacement. Directly retaining an unaligned membrane state is also problematic because a moving joint may occupy a different location in the next image. SNN recurrence is therefore neither cost-free nor inherently motion-aware video memory.
blocks.zh: Spiking神经网络(SNNs)为空间编码提供了替代计算原始[9]. 生物启发 SNN单位在潜在重排或衰减前越过一个阈值后,将输入积聚为连续膜潜力,并发出离散的悬崖. 这种阈值,事件驱动的行为取代了模拟神经网络密集的乘法操作,以稀疏,积累为基础的更新,这是广泛报道给SNN的能源效率的一个关键原因. 然而,SNN是当地为同步事件流而设计的。 一项核心的公开挑战就是将其缩放到并非内在基于事件的图像和视频理解等任务中,其中输入以密集同步帧的方式到达 [10]. 通过在几个步骤[11,12]上提供静态图像和无滚动膜动力,对物体探测和视觉主干进行了阈值振动. 视频引入了一个重要的区别:内部更新指数\\ tau描述了适用于观测的神经动力学,而物理帧指数 t t 只有在获得新的观测时才能进步. 在固定 t t 中增加 \ tau 可能精细化相同的图像表示,但不能显示框间位移 。 直接保留一个不结盟的膜状态也有问题,因为移动的关节可能在下一个图像中占据不同的位置. 因此,SNN的重现既不是免费的,也不是内在具有运动意识的视频内存.

blocks.en: SpikePose assigns spatial encoding to a frame-reset, single-step SNN and cross-frame reasoning to motion-aligned heatmap memory (MAM). MAM estimates joint displacement from consecutive predictions and aligns historical heatmaps before fusion. Related motion-aware heatmap regression incorporates joint movement into heatmap targets [ 13 ] . Here, motion instead controls a recurrent heatmap state. This design keeps temporal processing outside the high-dimensional backbone. Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: SpikePose将空间编码指定为帧重置,单步SNN和跨帧推理,用于运动对齐的热映射内存(MAM). MAM对连续预测产生的联合迁移进行估算,并在聚变前将历史热图对齐. 相关的运动意识热图回归将联合运动纳入热图目标[13]. 在这里,运动可以控制一个经常性的热映射状态. 这种设计将时间处理保留在高维主干线之外. 我们的贡献有三个方面:

blocks.en: • A novel compact 2D video HPE system that combines single-step spiking spatial encoding with an independent temporal state, evaluated against an architecture-matched ANN to quantify its accuracy–energy trade-off. • A lightweight MAM that aligns and adaptively retains heatmap history, to reduce frame-wise SNN’s motion errors with minimal computational overheads. • Comprehensive validation on both the MPII image benchmark and the NTU60 video dataset, with component and filtering analyses assessing individual architectural contribution.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the overall pipeline. Throughout this paper, SpikePose denotes the complete encoder–MAM system, whereas SpikePose w/o MAM denotes its frame-wise SNN variant without MAM. Specifically, the frame-reset spiking spatial encoder ( f Θ SNN f_{\Theta}^{\text{SNN}} ) processes each RGB frame independently using a single-step spiking inference schedule ( T snn = 1 T_{\text{snn}}=1 ). By resetting the internal neuronal state before every frame, it extracts per-frame spatial heatmaps ( H t H_{t} ) without carrying unaligned membrane history across frames. To handle cross-frame reasoning, the lightweight motion-aligned heatmap memory (MAM) module ( g Φ g_{\Phi} ) maintains a compact state R t = ( M t , C t , q t ) R_{t}=(M_{t},C_{t},q_{t}) across frames. Operating entirely outside the high-dimensional backbone, MAM estimates joint displacement, warps historical heatmaps, and applies adaptive gating and residual fusion to significantly reduce motion errors with minimal computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 图1显示整个管道。 在整个本文中,SpikePose表示的是完整的编码器-MAM系统,而SpikePose w/o MAM则表示其框架性SNN变体,没有MAM. 具体地说,帧重置spilling 空间编码器(f $ SNN f _{\ Theta}^{\text{SNN}} }} }})使用单步悬浮推算表(Tnn = 1 T_{\text{snn}}=1)独立处理每个RGB帧. 通过在每个帧之前重置内神经态,它提取每个帧的空间热图(H t H_{t}),而不会携带不匹配的膜历史跨帧. 为了处理跨帧推理,轻量级运动相配热映射(MAM)模块(g Φ Φ _{\ Phi})保持紧凑态 R t = (M t, C t, q t) R_{t}=(M_{t}),C_{t},q_{t})跨帧. 完全在高维主干线之外运行,MAM估计联合迁移,曲速历史热图,并应用适应性的引光和剩余聚变来大大减少运动误差,同时尽量减少计算间接费用.

blocks.en: 2.1 Single-Step Frame-Reset Spiking Spatial Encoder
blocks.zh: 2.1 单步框架重置空间编码器

blocks.en: The encoder maps a 256 × 256 256\times 256 crop to 16 joint heatmaps of size 64 × 64 64\times 64 through four progressively downsampling stages. An analog stem first extracts low-level features before the representation is handed off to spiking stages, which use I-LIF–Conv–BN operations to perform downsampling while keeping activations in the integer, event-driven spiking domain. These stages further rely on membrane-shortcut blocks [ 14 ] to preserve gradient flow and maintain training stability despite the network’s discrete, threshold-based activations. The final stage incorporates spatial attention to help the network focus on informative joint regions, while a spiking feature pyramid [ 15 ] fuses multi-scale features into a unified representation before a lightweight analog head decodes the final heatmaps. This design keeps almost all computation within the energy-efficient spiking domain, reserving analog operations for the input and output stages where precision is most critical.
blocks.zh: 编码器将一个256×256256\时的256个作物映射到16个大小64×64\时的联热图64,通过四个逐渐下降的采样阶段. 一个模拟干首先提取低级特性,然后才将表示传递到悬浮阶段,这些悬浮阶段使用I-LIF–Conv–BN操作来进行下采样,同时在整数,事件驱动的悬浮域中保持激活. 这些阶段还依赖于膜短块[14],以保持梯度流动并保持训练稳定性,尽管网络有离散的、以阈值为基础的激活。 最后阶段包含空间关注,以帮助网络关注信息化联合区域,而一个尖锐的特征金字塔[15]在轻量级模拟头解码最终热图之前,将多尺度特征引信成统一代表. 这种设计将几乎所有的计算都保留在节能溢出域内,为精度最高的输入和输出阶段保留模拟操作.

blocks.en: 2.3 Training Objective
blocks.zh: 2.3 培训目标

blocks.en:
Heatmap targets are unit-peak Gaussians with σ = 2 \sigma=2 heatmap pixels. Training back-propagates through each 16-frame window without detaching MAM state. The total objective combines the primary pose loss ( L p ​ o ​ s ​ e L_{pose} ) with auxiliary displacement supervision ( L o ​ f ​ f ​ s ​ e ​ t L_{offset} ).
Specifically, L p ​ o ​ s ​ e L_{pose} measures the mean-squared error on visible joints of the fused output H ^ t \widehat{H}_{t} , normalised by the number of valid heatmap elements. L o ​ f ​ f ​ s ​ e ​ t L_{offset} applies a Smooth L ​ 1 L1 penalty to train the displacement branch using ground-truth coordinate differences across valid adjacent-frame pairs in 𝒱 \mathcal{V} :

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: Implementation details. For MAM training and validation, each source video contributes two deterministic, non-overlapping 16-frame clips sampled at uniformly spaced temporal centres. Frames are consecutive (stride one), training shuffles only the window order, and all frames within a window share the same crop and augmentation. Training resets MAM state at each sampled clip boundary. Complete-video evaluation retains MAM state across inference chunks and resets it at video boundaries. The neuronal state is reset before every physical frame.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 就MAM培训和验证而言,每个源视频都提供了两个确定性、非重叠的16帧短片,在统一空间的时间中心取样。 框架是连续的(第1步),训练只洗动窗口顺序,窗口内的所有框架共享相同的裁剪和增强. 在每个取样的剪辑边界上重新培训MAM状态。 完整视频评价保留了跨推断块的MAM状态,并在视频边界重置. 神经态在每个物理框架之前重置.

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: Image dataset. MPII is an in-the-wild 2D HPE benchmark with about 25,000 images and over 40,000 annotated people covering diverse human activities [ 17 ] . We use its official validation split to evaluate the frame-wise spatial encoder.
blocks.zh: 图像数据集. MPII是一个内在的2DHPE基准,有大约25,000幅图像和超过40,000个注解人物,涵盖各种人类活动[17]. 我们用它的官方验证分解来评估帧式空间编码器.

blocks.en: Video dataset. NTU RGB+D 60 (NTU60) is a large-scale indoor multimodal dataset containing 56,880 video samples across 60 action classes, with synchronised RGB, depth, infrared, and 3D skeleton streams [ 18 ] . We evaluate the complete video model under the official Cross-Subject split using a frozen stratified test subset of 4,563 videos and 419,968 physical frames. Kinect RGB-plane joints are mapped from NTU-25 to the MPII-style 16-joint layout, and all methods use one fixed skeleton-derived 256 × 256 256\times 256 tube crop per complete video. Full videos are processed sequentially. The MAM state is carried across inference chunks and reset only at source-video boundaries. Duplicate spatial predictions from an overlapping terminal extraction window are discarded.
blocks.zh: 视频数据集. NTU RGB+D 60(NTU60)是一个大型室内多式联运数据集,包含56,880个视频样本,跨越60个动作类,具有同步RGB,深度,红外线,以及3D骨架流[18]. 我们使用4,563个视频和419,968个物理帧的冷冻分层测试子集,对正式的跨子块分割下的完整视频模型进行评估. Kinect RGB-plane 关节由NTU-25映射到MPII风格的16-联动布局,所有方法都使用一个固定骨架衍生的256×256/256\times 256管作物每完整视频. 完整视频按顺序处理. MAM状态是跨越推论块,仅在源视频边界重置. 重叠终端提取窗口的重复空间预测被丢弃。

blocks.en: Mean Per-Joint Velocity Error (MPJVE) and Mean Per-Joint Acceleration Error (MPJAccE) measure the mean Euclidean discrepancies between the first- and second-order finite differences of predicted and ground-truth 2D joint trajectories, respectively [ 19 , 20 ] . Their units are pixels/frame and pixels/frame 2 . Both metrics are computed from reconstructed full-video trajectories, include valid differences across inference-window boundaries, and are averaged equally across videos.
blocks.zh: 平均偶联高速差错(MPJVE)和平均偶联加速差错(MPJAccE)分别测量预测的和地面真实的2D联合轨迹的一级和二级有限差值之间的平均欧几里得系数差[19,20]. 他们的单位是像素/帧和像素/帧2 . 这两个指标都是从重建的全视轨迹计算出来的,包括跨推论-窗口边界的有效差异,并在视频之间平均。

blocks.en: Computation and arithmetic energy. Costs are reported for 256 × 256 256\times 256 input crops. Analytical GFLOPs count dense convolutional/linear operations and supported additional operators, with two FLOPs per multiply-Accumulation operations(MACs). Here, it covers real-valued convolutional/linear paths. We distinguish MACs from spike-driven Accumulate operations(ACs) using integer-spike accounting [ 12 , 16 ] . SNN activity is averaged over 28,404 16-frame windows from full-video evaluation. Using 45-nm FP32 reference costs of 4.6 pJ/MAC and 0.9 pJ/AC [ 21 ] , we estimate: E proxy ​ ( mJ ) = 4.6 ​ N MAC + 0.9 ​ N AC 10 9 . E_{\mathrm{proxy}}(\mathrm{mJ})=\frac{4.6N_{\mathrm{MAC}}+0.9N_{\mathrm{AC}}}{10^{9}}. (14) Softmax, warping, membrane updates, element-wise fusion, and memory/data movement are not fully covered. This energy proxy reflects analytical computational costs rather than directly measured device energy or execution latency.
blocks.zh: 计算与算术能量. 256×256256\时256种投入作物的成本报告。 分析的GFLOPs计算了密集的演化/线性操作,并支持额外的操作器,每个乘积操作(MAC)有两个FLOP. 在这里,它涵盖了真实价值的演化/线性路径. 我们用整数-spike核算法将MAC与钉子驱动的累积操作区分开来[12,16]. SNN活动从全视频评价中平均超过28,404个16帧窗口. 使用45-nm的FP32参考成本为4.6 pJ/MAC和0.9 pJ/AC [21],我们估计: E 代理 (mJ) = 4.6 N MAC + 0.9 N AC 10 9. E _{\ mathrm{proxy}}(\mathrm{mJ}) =\ frac{4.6 N_{\ mathrm{MAC}}+0.9 N_{\ mathrm{AC}}}{10^{9}}. (14)软max,warping,膜更新,元素核聚变,以及内存/数据运动等功能没有完全覆盖. 这种能量代用反应了分析计算成本,而不是直接测量的设备能量或执行延迟.

blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: SpikePose achieves PCK HB ​ ( 0.5 ) = 83.81 \mathrm{PCK}_{\mathrm{HB}}(0.5)=83.81 , a MPJVE of 3.50, and an MPJAccE of 5.50. Relative to SpikePose w/o MAM, it increases PCK HB ​ ( 0.5 ) \mathrm{PCK}_{\mathrm{HB}}(0.5) by 0.18 0.18 points while reducing MPJVE and MPJAccE by 28.13% and 31.46%, respectively. MAM adds 0.003M parameters and approximately 0.0023 analytical GFLOPs per processed frame. Overall, its main benefit is improved motion quality along with a subtle localisation gain.
blocks.zh: SpikePose实现PCK HB(0.5)=83.81\mathrm{PCK}_{\mathrm{HB}}(0.5)=83.81,MPJVE为3.50,MPJAccE为5.50. 相对于SpikePose w/o MAM,它分别将PCK HB(0.5)\mathrm{PCK}_{\mathrm{HB}}(0.5)增加0.180.18分,同时将MPJVE和MPJAccE分别减少28.13%和31.46%. MAM增加了0.003M参数,每个处理框架约0.0023个分析GFLOP. 总的来说,其主要好处是运动质量的提高以及微妙的本地化收益。

blocks.en:
SpikePose bridges the performance gap that traditionally hinders spiking neural networks in complex video tasks, achieving competitive accuracy relative to its analog counterparts.
While, HRNet-W32 and the architecture-matched SpikePose–ANN exceed SpikePose in PCK HB ​ ( 0.5 ) \mathrm{PCK}_{\mathrm{HB}}(0.5) by 2.54 and 1.12 points, respectively (86.35 and 84.93 versus 83.81), SpikePose matches the operation count of the architecture-matched ANN while uses 58.78% fewer analytical GFLOPs and 73.64% fewer parameters than HRNet-W32.
By successfully narrowing this accuracy deficit under a spike-driven framework, SpikePose establishes a scalable and highly efficient accuracy-motion-computation operating point for real-world deployment.
blocks.zh:
SpikePose弥补了传统上阻碍神经网络在复杂的视频任务中飞跃的性能差距,实现了相对于模拟对等器的竞争精度.
而HRNet-W32和架构配对的SpikePose–ANN在PCK HB(0.5)\mathrm{PCK}_{\mathrm{HB}}(0.5)中分别以2.54和1.12分(86.35和84.93对83.81)超过了SpikePose, Pose匹配了架构匹配的ANN的操作计数,而使用的分析GFLOP比HRNet-W32少58.78%,参数少73.64%.
SpikePose通过成功缩小这种在钉子驱动框架下的精度不足,为实际世界的部署建立了一个可伸缩和高效的精度-运动-计算操作点。

blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: MPII spatial encoder results. Table 2 compares spatial accuracy and estimated arithmetic energy on MPII. SpikePose–ANN w/o MAM and single-step SpikePose w/o MAM obtain PCKh ⁡ ( 0.5 ) \mathrm{PCKh}(0.5) scores of 87.05 and 85.84, respectively. With similar analytical computation of 8.44 and 8.46 GFLOPs per crop, the single-step SNN reduces estimated arithmetic energy from 19.309 to 1.820 mJ per crop (90.6%). Increasing T snn T_{\mathrm{snn}} to 2 improves PCKh to 86.16 but raises estimated energy to 2.984 mJ per crop.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We presented SpikePose, a lightweight video HPE system that separates spatial and temporal processing: a frame-reset spiking encoder produces per-frame heatmaps with a single internal update, while MAM confines cross-frame reasoning to a compact, aligned heatmap memory outside the backbone. Experiments on MPII and a frozen NTU60 subset show that MAM substantially improves motion consistency at negligible additional cost, and that SpikePose narrows the accuracy gap with its ANN heatmap-based counterpart while retaining the energy advantages characteristic of spiking computation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了SpikePose,一个轻量级的视频HPE系统,它将空间处理和时间处理分开:一个帧重置的sping编码器产生每帧热映射,并进行单一的内部更新,而MAM将跨帧推理局限于骨干外的紧凑,对齐的热映射内存. 在MPII和一个冷冻的NTU60子集上的实验显示,MAM以可忽略不计的额外费用大幅度提高了运动一致性,SpikePose用基于ANN热映射的对应物缩小了精度差距,同时保留了Spiking计算中的能量优势特征.
